news.q: Candy maker Mars just announced a $1.4 billion U.S. investment. Its Waco, Texas, plant makes more than how many billion candy pieces a year?
news.fact: That's Snickers, Starburst and Skittles; Mars says 94% of the Mars products sold in the U.S. are made here.

news.q: NASA just picked a group of companies to compete for up to $10 billion in cargo deliveries for its planned Moon Base. How many companies made the cut?
news.fact: SpaceX, Blue Origin and Lockheed Martin are among the companies picked.

easy.q: How many years long is one term for a U.S. president?
easy.fact: The 22nd Amendment limits presidents to two elected terms.

easy.q: How many Infinity Stones does Thanos collect in the Marvel movies?
easy.fact: They control space, mind, reality, power, time and soul.

easy.q: How many oceans does the world have, by most modern counts?
easy.fact: The Southern Ocean around Antarctica was the latest to be widely recognized.

easy.q: How many points is a field goal worth in the NFL?
How many Ghostbusters suit up in the original 1984 movie?
easy.fact: Their headquarters was a real New York firehouse in Tribeca.

medium.q: In what year did the stock market crash that kicked off the Great Depression?
medium.fact: The worst day, Oct. 29, is remembered as Black Tuesday.

medium.q: How many seasons of The Walking Dead were made?
medium.fact: The show ran on AMC from 2010 to 2022.

medium.q: How many boroughs make up New York City?
medium.fact: Brooklyn has the most people of the five.

medium.q: How many Super Bowls have the Pittsburgh Steelers won?
medium.fact: Four of them came in the 1970s.

medium.q: How many Oscars did Parasite win in 2020?
medium.fact: It was the first non-English-language film to win Best Picture.

hard.q: How many essays make up The Federalist Papers?
hard.fact: Hamilton, Madison and Jay all wrote under the pen name Publius.

hard.q: Not counting Mexico City, how many states does Mexico have?
hard.fact: Chihuahua is the biggest by area.

hard.q: How many touchdown passes did Peyton Manning throw in his NFL career?
hard.fact: He threw a record 55 of them in 2013 alone.

hard.q: How many episodes of Gilmore Girls aired in its original seven seasons?
hard.fact: Netflix added four more in the 2016 revival.
